mcqs.question: Which landing site was selected for Chandrayaan-4’s sample-return mission, planned for launch by 2028?
options: MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region at the lunar south pole
IN-SPACe Satellite Bus as a Service (SBaaS)
mcqs.explanation: Chandrayaan-4’s landing site is MM-4 in the Mons Mouton region at the lunar south pole. The site was chosen from four sites using OHRC images. SBaaS, TPG-1000C and the 2-nanometre chip are separate developments and not lunar landing sites.
